script.title: America's Unknown Soldier got a guard because of picnics
sentences: America's Unknown Soldier first got a guard because of picnics.
On November 17, 1925, Arlington posted a civilian to stop families picnicking on the flat marble slab.
Soldiers took over in 1926, and the watch hasn't stopped since 1937.
Not for weather, not for terrorist attacks.
The guard marches 21 steps, faces the Tomb for 21 seconds, turns, waits 21 more.
Guards spend about six hours readying a heavy wool uniform for each shift.
If the crowd gets loud, the guard steps off the mat to confront it.

claims_en: A civilian guard was first posted at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier on 17 November 1925.
Its purpose was, among other things, to prevent families from picnicking on the flat marble slab with views of the city.
A military guard was first posted in 1926 (25 March).
The first 24-hour guard was posted on 2 July 1937, and the watch has been maintained continuously since.
Inclement weather and terrorist attacks have never caused the watch to cease.
The guard marches 21 steps, faces the Tomb for 21 seconds, turns and waits 21 seconds.
A guard takes an average of 6 hours to prepare his heavy wool uniform for the next day's work.
If a disturbance occurs, the sentinel exits the mat and confronts it.
